review_points.summary: Recovery observation can overwrite a concurrently accepted final result with failed task/attempt state.
review_points.trigger: Worker result ingestion or spool replay commits while _inspect_attempt_recovery_with_metadata runs after the new conn.commit; cached received_result remains false.
review_points.impact: Supervisor continues recovery/failure logic despite accepted worker_results. Isolated no-progress case leaves worker_results=1 but task and attempt failed; completed-only audit cannot consume it. A progress-bearing case can instead initiate an unnecessary resume.
review_points.suggested_action: After every released-writer recovery/process operation, acquire the writer and revalidate latest attempt, owner and worker_results before choosing recovery/failure; route a newly received result through receipt supervision. Add this concurrent receipt regression.

target_verification.conclusion: Writer reacquisition and snapshot/latest-attempt/result-ID/owner revalidation now reject stale observations. Original receipt-during-recovery repro leaves attempt completed and task running with the accepted result, not failed. Tests also cover receipt during timeout cleanup.

review_points.followup_note: Fix is unchanged from independently reviewed a669934f snapshot except for separately tracked FINAL-04 exception propagation. Prior source/path evidence and fixed-path checks remain valid.

review_points.summary: A control process group exiting at the timeout boundary raises ProcessLookupError and terminates the daemon.
review_points.trigger: communicate times out, then the whole group exits before either os.killpg call.
review_points.impact: Uncaught ProcessLookupError bypasses structured child_timeout and _reconcile_child_result; run_daemon catches it as fatal and stops polling. Managed-run cleanup is postponed until restart/other recovery.
review_points.suggested_action: Handle absent groups around TERM/KILL as an exit race, reap and verify group liveness, and preserve executor_id plus structured child_timeout so managed-run cleanup still executes. Add TERM/KILL exit-race coverage.

target_verification.conclusion: TERM and KILL ProcessLookupError are handled. Reaping plus independent group liveness proof retain structured child_timeout/executor nonce; a missing signal target alone still does not prove group stopped.

review_points.followup_note: Fix is unchanged from independently reviewed a669934f snapshot except for separately tracked FINAL-04 exception propagation. Prior source/path evidence and fixed-path checks remain valid.

review_points.summary: Remaining control deadline is still ignored on supported remediation worktree and publication command paths.
review_points.trigger: CI/merge-conflict remediation selects prepare_existing_pr_worktree, or local publication starts near the control deadline.
review_points.impact: Raw Git calls have no timeout, and publication calls retain a fixed 60-second cap; remaining-budget exhaustion still causes the daemon outer timeout to kill execution during Git/GitHub I/O instead of completing the intended cooperative deadline path. Executor cleanup reduces lease residue but does not complete this R06 subclaim.
review_points.suggested_action: Apply common.run_command with runner injection to remaining supported long Git/gh paths, including prepare_existing_pr_worktree and publish bounded_command, and test that an expired deadline prevents invocation. Preserve publication intent/reconciliation handling.

target_verification.conclusion: Identified supported long command paths now call common.run_command with injected runner and remaining deadline. Expired worktree/publish commands are not invoked. New swallowing semantics at two adjacent inspection consumers are separately tracked as FINAL-04.

review_points.summary: Recovery and audit swallow expected command deadline timeouts and use missing observation as evidence of task failure or scope violation.
review_points.trigger: Remaining control deadline is exhausted while observing a dead worker worktree or collecting controller-owned Git HEAD/origin scope.
review_points.impact: _run_inspection_command catches TimeoutExpired under SubprocessError; recovery treats the absent stdout as no_progress and supervisor fails the task/closes the owner despite saved work. _action_scope_for_result also suppresses TimeoutExpired and can audit a valid fork PR action against missing head_owner, rejecting valid output permanently.

scope_expired_budget.violation: open_pr head owner is outside the assigned repository

review_points.suggested_action: Propagate TimeoutExpired from these evidence-gathering helpers to existing _run_repo_pipeline execution_deadline handling, retaining task/result/owner for a later tick. Add behavior tests that assert no domain failure/resume/rejected audit or incomplete persisted scope on observation timeout.
review_points.proposed_remedy_assessment: Correct and implemented at reviewed target; no new exception type needed. Any observation timeout aborts incomplete evidence rather than establishing absence of progress or a narrower trusted scope.

target_verification.conclusion: TimeoutExpired propagates from both observation helpers. Independent dirty-worktree comparison retains original behavior with budget (one resume) and, at expired budget, raises TimeoutExpired with original running attempt/task and active owner unchanged, without creating a resume. Scope comparison retains valid fork head_owner without timeout and raises on expiry, preserving accepted action. Full run_once caller returns execution_deadline and releases its run lease while retaining running business state for next tick.
